scripts.reset:docker: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml down && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml up -d --build
scripts.set:permissions: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml exec ojs chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html/cache /var/www/html/public /var/www/files
scripts.start: npm run build:docker && npm run set:permissions
